items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: How did I meet Ed? I don’t know. Maybe through IASJ. I don’t remember how we first met.

ctx.x: This is where I first got the idea of Billy and Cecil as a team. That’s Ed’s record. Ed came through University of Michigan. How did I meet Ed? I don’t know. Maybe through IASJ. I don’t remember how we first met.
Here’s another solo soprano record called The Tree that you did in Milan.
